title: Working on a new title screen for Wobbly Warfare
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: What is the core loop about?

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
XCOM meets Slay the Spire with active ragdoll physics system. 

You start with 5 characters each equipped with a pistol and random stats/traits. As you go along you upgrade them, lose them as they perish in combat, recruit new members, etc.

comments.author: hushzephyr
comments.body: I love this kind of cartoon rendering. If the trees were a bit more detailed, the overall effect would be even better.

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
